assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing two-panel forest riverbank review image. Change ONLY LEFT PANEL: provide a clearly continuous DRY RETURN STAIR from the lower weighing quay beside the small roofed stone weight up to the high stone public path behind it. Place sturdy short stone stair along LEFT SIDE of the weighing shelter, running up the bank, solid bottom landing connected to dry quay and solid top landing joining high path. Cut an appropriate OPEN gap in high path's front rail at the stair top, with side handrail protection, no gate. Remove only the local rock/wall/vegetation necessary for stair, keep river outside stairs. Important: this is not another stair descending into water. Keep the existing raft, rope moorings, weighing shelter and stone weight, water and forest; keep RIGHT PANEL house intact, detached beam storage and ground exits unchanged. Preserve camera, muted pixel palette and paired composition. No new people, captions, permission or relocation claims, demolition, magic or other new objects. Main correction is an obvious dry walking connection between low quay and upper public path.
assets.qa: Added visible dry stone staircase left of weighing shelter connects low quay vicinity to high embankment path, with open rail gap. Upper stair extends to higher forest edge as a generator addition; low landing connection is narrow near mooring post and needs collision/height validation. Right intact house, detached beams and raft preserved broadly, not pixel-exact. No relocation, owner consent or carrying capacity inferred. Prefer v2 over original dry-egress obstruction.
